result.instructions: Access to Muesli, a local meeting transcriber. Use get_status to see whether a meeting is detected or being recorded, list_transcripts to find meetings, and get_transcript to read one. A transcript is complete when its state is "ready". Finished meetings can be managed: rename_transcript, set_attendees, rename_speaker (for example "Others" to a person's name) and delete_transcript, which moves the files to the macOS Trash. Confirm with the user before deleting. Recordings cannot be started or stopped. The vocabulary (get_vocabulary, update_vocabulary) holds names and terms Muesli spells right in future transcripts: when the user corrects a misheard name or term, add the right spelling.

tools.description: Whether Muesli is running, whether a call or meeting is detected, whether it is recording, and the most recent finished transcript.
tools.name: get_status
tools.title: Muesli status

tools.description: List meetings known to Muesli, newest first. state is recording, finalizing, ready or failed; only ready transcripts are complete.

since.description: ISO 8601 date-time; only meetings started at or after it.

tools.name: list_transcripts
tools.title: List transcripts

tools.description: Read one meeting transcript by id. Works while the meeting is still recording (partial is then true). Long transcripts are paged: when truncated is true, call again with fromSeconds set to nextFromSeconds.

fromSeconds.description: Only segments starting at or after this offset.

id.description: Meeting id from list_transcripts or get_status.

toSeconds.description: Only segments starting before this offset.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.title: Get transcript

tools.description: Change a finished meeting's title. The transcript files in the user's folder are renamed to match.

id.description: Meeting id from list_transcripts or get_status.

tools.name: rename_transcript
tools.title: Rename transcript

tools.description: Replace the attendee list of a finished meeting. Pass an empty list to clear it.

id.description: Meeting id from list_transcripts or get_status.

tools.name: set_attendees
tools.title: Set attendees

tools.description: Rename a speaker label in a finished transcript, for every segment with that label. Muesli labels the microphone "You" and everyone else "Others".

id.description: Meeting id from list_transcripts or get_status.

tools.name: rename_speaker
tools.title: Rename speaker

tools.description: The names and terms Muesli asks its speech model to spell right (people, products, jargon, acronyms), oldest first.
tools.name: get_vocabulary
tools.title: Get vocabulary

tools.description: Add or remove names and terms Muesli should spell right in future transcripts. Add the correct spelling when the user corrects a misheard name or term; never ordinary words. Existing transcripts are not changed. Returns the whole list.

add.description: Terms to add, spelled as they should appear.

tools.name: update_vocabulary
tools.title: Update vocabulary

tools.description: Delete a finished meeting. Its transcript files are moved to the macOS Trash, so the user can restore them. Ask the user to confirm first.

id.description: Meeting id from list_transcripts or get_status.

tools.name: delete_transcript
tools.title: Delete transcript
